Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, M.R. SHAH
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s. 378 – Appeal against acquittal – Grant of leave to appeal against order of acquittal by trial court – Principles to be considered by the High Court – On facts, trial court acquitted second to sixth respondents under the Penal Code and Dowry Prohibition Act – Application for leave to appeal by the informant – Rejected by the High Court – On appeal, held: Judgment of the High Court did not meet the requirements to be observed, consistent with the provisions of s. 378 – High Court
Decision Date : 20-07-2021 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 646/2021 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
